headline: Chest-high peaks on a good angle, light dawn wind — worth a look if you're out east.
today: Best-shaped of the small days: 1.4-1.7ft at up to 7.7s from a good SE angle, glassy at dawn before the WNW cross-off fills in. Longboard the morning around the incoming tide toward the 3:29p high. Not a drive-from-the-city day, but a solid one if you're already in Montauk.

daysToWatch.note: 2-2.4ft with longer-period E lines and offshore wind through morning. Cleanest Ditch day of the week — shortboard or fish early before the WSW cross comes up.
Real size in the water but 25-28mph wind torches it. Blown, stay home.
